process.title: Tell us about the garden
process.text: Send photos and rough sizes, and tell us how you want to use the space.

process.title: Visit and design
process.text: We check levels and access and agree a design, with a concept drawing where useful.

process.title: Detailed written quotation
process.text: You receive a written quotation for the structure and any other garden work.

process.title: Build
process.text: Our crew builds it on site.

faqs.a: The size of the deck or structure, the materials, whether it has a roof, and the ground conditions and levels. Your detailed written quotation sets it out.

faqs.q: I want a covered area I can use in the rain. Is a pergola right?
faqs.a: A timber veranda, open or enclosed with sliding glass, may suit better. See our timber verandas and glass rooms page.
It depends on the size, height and position. We check your site first, and a Section 5 declaration from the council gives certainty.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.
